
cdrom/cd-speed-seek3
When the sled starts and the drive stops seeking after a speed change: per seek the cell, the control's and the polled
seek's write-to-INT2 (M cycles), then P<time>:<sector less target> (GetlocP) and S<time>:<stat> (Getstat) where they
changed; | marks the INT2. No assertions.
